resources.name: coe-results
resources.title: COE bidding results, every round since 2010
resources.description: Every Certificate of Entitlement bidding round since January 2010, category by category: the quota premium, quota, bids received and successful, the premium in today's dollars, and the Prevailing Quota Premium for the next month.

fields.name: month
fields.description: The month of the bidding exercise.

fields.name: round
fields.description: The round in that month: 1 or 2.

fields.name: closing_date
fields.description: The day bidding closed; from January 2024.

fields.name: category
fields.description: COE category: A (smaller cars), B (larger cars), C (goods vehicles and buses), D (motorcycles), E (open).

fields.name: quota_premium_sgd
fields.description: The quota premium: what every successful bidder in the category pays.

fields.name: quota
fields.description: How many COEs were on offer.

fields.name: successful_bids
fields.description: How many bids won a COE.

fields.name: bids_received
fields.description: How many bids were made.

fields.name: premium_in_latest_cpi_month_sgd
fields.description: The quota premium in today's money, using SingStat's CPI for the latest month; the month is in the CSV column's name.

fields.name: pqp_for_next_month_sgd
fields.description: The Prevailing Quota Premium for renewing a COE next month: the mean of the last six rounds' premiums, rounded up. Given on each month's second round for categories A to D, from March 2010.

resources.name: cpf-wage-ceilings
resources.title: CPF Ordinary Wage ceiling, since 1955
resources.description: The Ordinary Wage ceiling, the most monthly pay CPF contributions are worked out on, for every change since July 1955.

sources.title: Central Provident Fund Board, via data.gov.sg

fields.name: from
fields.description: The month this ceiling took effect.

fields.name: ordinary_wage_ceiling_sgd
fields.description: Pay above this in a month earns no CPF contributions.

fields.name: source
fields.description: The CPF Board document or data.gov.sg dataset the row is taken from.

resources.name: income-tax-rates
resources.title: Singapore resident income tax rates
resources.description: IRAS's progressive income tax rates for tax residents, band by band: where each band starts and ends, its rate, the tax on the whole band and the total tax up to its top, for Year of Assessment 2024 onwards.

sources.title: Singapore Statutes Online: Income Tax Act 1947

fields.name: band
fields.description: The band, from the lowest income up.

fields.name: from_sgd
fields.description: Where the band starts.

fields.name: to_sgd
fields.description: Where the band ends; blank (the CSV says no limit) for the top band.

fields.name: rate_pct
fields.description: The tax rate on the part of chargeable income in this band.

fields.name: tax_on_band_sgd
fields.description: The tax on the whole band; blank for the open-ended top band.

fields.name: tax_up_to_band_top_sgd
fields.description: The total tax on chargeable income up to the top of this band.

fields.name: applies
fields.description: The Years of Assessment these rates apply to, in IRAS's terms.

resources.name: sora
resources.title: SORA and Compounded SORA, daily
resources.description: The Singapore Overnight Rate Average for every business day since July 2005, with MAS's SORA Index, the 1, 3 and 6-month Compounded SORA, and, from August 2020, the volume and the highest and lowest rates traded.

fields.name: value_date
fields.description: The business day the rate is for.

fields.name: publication_date
fields.description: The day MAS published it, usually the next business day.

fields.name: sora_pct
fields.description: SORA: the volume-weighted average rate of unsecured overnight interbank S$ lending that day.

fields.name: sora_index
fields.description: MAS's SORA Index, which compounds SORA day by day; the change between two dates gives the compounded rate between them.

fields.name: compounded_1m_pct
fields.description: 1-month Compounded SORA: SORA compounded over the month before the publication date (MAS's figure from 6 Aug 2020; ours, by MAS's method, before that).

fields.name: compounded_3m_pct
fields.description: 3-month Compounded SORA, worked out the same way over three months. Most SORA home loans use this one.

fields.name: compounded_6m_pct
fields.description: 6-month Compounded SORA, worked out the same way over six months.

fields.name: volume_sgd_m
fields.description: Total overnight lending SORA was worked out from that day.

fields.name: highest_rate_pct
fields.description: The highest rate among the trades that day.

fields.name: lowest_rate_pct
fields.description: The lowest rate among the trades that day.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Where the row comes from.

resources.name: tbill-auctions
resources.title: Singapore T-bill auction results
resources.description: Every MAS auction of 6-month and 1-year Singapore Treasury bills since May 1987: the cut-off yield and price, the yield on the cash you actually pay, the median and average yields, the amount sold, total bids and how much of each kind of bid was filled.

fields.name: auction_date
fields.description: The day the auction closed and the result was published.

fields.name: tbill
fields.description: Which T-bill: 6-month or 1-year.

fields.name: issue_code
fields.description: MAS's issue code, the code you apply for at a bank or ATM.

fields.name: issue_date
fields.description: The day the T-bill is issued and paid for.

fields.name: maturity_date
fields.description: The day it pays back its face value.

fields.name: days
fields.description: Days from issue to maturity.

fields.name: cutoff_yield_pct
fields.description: The cut-off yield: the highest yield MAS accepted, which every successful bidder gets.

fields.name: cutoff_price_sgd_per_100
fields.description: What you pay for every S$100 you get back at maturity.

fields.name: yield_on_cash_paid_pct
fields.description: The return on the cash you actually pay (the discounted price), which is a little above the cut-off yield.

fields.name: median_yield_pct
fields.description: The median yield of the competitive bids that were accepted; MAS records none before November 2009.

fields.name: average_yield_pct
fields.description: The average yield of the competitive bids that were accepted.

fields.name: amount_sold_sgd_m
fields.description: How much MAS sold at the auction.

fields.name: bids_sgd_m
fields.description: How much was bid for in total.

fields.name: bid_to_cover
fields.description: Total bids divided by the amount sold: above 1 means more was asked for than was sold.

fields.name: non_competitive_filled_pct
fields.description: How much of each non-competitive bid (no yield named, the usual choice for individuals) was filled; none before the 27 Nov 2002 auction, the first where MAS records non-competitive bids allotted.

fields.name: competitive_at_cutoff_filled_pct
fields.description: How much of each competitive bid at exactly the cut-off yield was filled; bids at a lower yield were filled in full.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Where the row comes from.
